visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up shot of a glass-door refrigerator in a Seven-Eleven store, filled with various plastic cups containing frozen fruit and vegetable chunks. A green sticker on the glass promotes an 'in-store made' green smoothie for 300.24 yen. (2) A hand wearing a grey knit glove reaches into the freezer and selects a cup labeled 'GREENS.' The cup clearly displays broccoli, pineapple, and green vegetables through its transparent sides. (3) The scene transitions to a white-tiled store area next to a smoothie blending machine. A person in a white coat peels back the green foil lid of the cup and places it into the machine's receptacle. (4) A close-up of the machine's digital interface shows a finger pressing a circular 'OK' button. The screen features both Japanese and English instructions for starting the blending process. (5) The machine door slides shut, and the cup is seen through the glass as the ingredients are blended into a bright green liquid. (6) While blending, the screen displays a cute animation featuring three cartoon animal characters (Chiikawa style) with the text 'Now blending.' (7) Once finished, the screen shows 'Your smoothie is ready.' The woman reaches in and retrieves the completed cup, which is now filled with a frothy green smoothie. (8) The camera pans to a medium shot of a woman with short brown hair wearing a white puffer coat. She inserts a white straw, stirs the drink, and takes a sip while smiling brightly at the camera.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 7-11. [Slogan]: お店で作るグリーンスムージー. [Subtitle]: ¥278(税込¥300.24) SEVEN CAFE. (2) [Slogan]: GREENS. 1/3日分の緑黄色野菜が摂れる. (3) [Slogan]: STEP 3 画面のボタンを押す Push button to start. (4) [Variety]: OK. [Slogan]: もどる Back. (5) [Slogan]: Now blending. (6) [Slogan]: Your smoothie is ready. 出来上がりました。

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 female main character appears in the latter half; gloved hands in the first half appear to belong to her.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A woman with short, dark brown hair, wearing a white puffer coat with a black crossbody bag strap.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The interior of a clean, well-lit Seven-Eleven convenience store. Background elements include a frozen goods cooler, the smoothie machine station, and a magazine rack near the checkout.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A fast-tempo, high-energy J-Pop track with a female vocalist begins immediately, characterized by bright synthesizer melodies and a strong dance beat. (2) A faint mechanical sliding sound is heard as the freezer door is opened. (3) As the cup lid is peeled, there is a subtle plastic rustling sound. (4) A percussive 'clunk' occurs as the cup is inserted into the blending machine. (5) A sharp digital 'beep' follows as the UI screen is tapped. (6) A sustained mechanical whirring sound of the blender is clearly audible, mixing with the music without drowning it out. (7) The music continues at a steady volume throughout the drinking sequence until the end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional showcase for the self-serve smoothie machines at Seven-Eleven Japan, highlighting the ease of use, the freshness of ingredients, and the satisfaction of the final product.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Clear branding of 7-Eleven and SEVEN CAFE, combined with a demonstration of purchasing and using the store's proprietary machine.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly effective short-form promotional clip using energetic music and clear POV shots to demonstrate consumer convenience.
